newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TML SEES 97/98 GROWTH FOR ESTABLISHED UNITS.
newsitem.headline: TML SEES 97/98 GROWTH FOR ESTABLISHED UNITS.

text.p: South African media group Times Media Ltd (TML) said on Monday its established operations should continue to show real growth in the new financial year provided business confidence remains strong.
At the same time losses from existing new ventures should decline in the coming year, TML said in a statement accompanying its year end results.
